shared_elements: round-topped (arched) upright slab with framed field
row of small standing human figures in the upper register
figures rendered frontally/in profile side by side
linear incised border or framing line following the arch
justification: Both are arched, framed upright fields divided into registers with a row of standing human figures across the top, which is the most specific shared trait. Beyond that the content diverges completely: A devotes its main field to a large mounted rider with animals beneath, rendered in bold modelled relief with a plaited border, while B fills nearly the whole surface with dense rows of small pictographic signs under a winged disc emblem, in a fine schematic incised manner.
